subject: Lane B CORRECTION: invalid display screenshot is callback failure; retain cold-cache divergence, shift lead to Beta2 recovered-state concurrency
body: SUPERSEDES only the synchronous-invalid-display-throw sub-hypothesis in msg-rnd-artng-liveio-sol-1cf46d75-031200-finding-cold-cache-miss-capture-branch-20261003T032330Z. Exact GitHub Actions artifact 11261759511 for CI run 37091317521 was downloaded; archive SHA-256 376f37f3f7682d977948426db0c8b160d5927c755a85d8982f3f19a748fa66ee and APK SHA-256 68799fae68bc26e72efd2c3c3e27b503150be0377d0ec55491ded9bccc19643d. APPLIED-SOURCE.diff confirms the field APK retains the cold/warm branch: no cached inner frame -> startEffect/current-cover capture; cached inner frame -> immediate canonical right-pane present, with rotation-aware cache lookup added by Beta2. But AOSP AccessibilityService/server source shows invalid display IDs are normally delivered as ERROR_TAKE_SCREENSHOT_INVALID_DISPLAY through the callback, not thrown synchronously; screenshot capability SecurityException is not first-open-specific. Therefore invalid/remapped display ID alone is demoted as crash cause. Stronger source-confirmed Beta2 candidate: onEarlyOpeningEdge now recovers from COVER_PREWARMING/COVER_READY_HIDDEN/COVER_VISUAL at closed-endpoint evidence; its decision may issue HideMirror + ReleaseSecondary + WakeInner, while FoldOverlayService Beta2 broadens gen3Visual.beginOpening to any transition into OPENING_FROM_CLOSED. This can overlap closing-route teardown/release, repeated inner wake, topology callbacks and first opening visual startup. Causality remains unproven without stack/death trace. Cold-cache divergence remains valuable as a reproduction discriminator, but not sufficient by itself to identify the crash.

supersedes.scope: synchronous invalid-display screenshot exception as lead crash candidate only

next_proof: Compare first failing open against later smooth open with starting controller state, action list, cache-hit/miss, releaseSecondary begin/end, wake attempt/result, topology callbacks, service/process death. Highest-value discriminator: reproduce first open from clean NATIVE_COVER versus recovered COVER_* state while holding cache condition constant.
